changelog:
Feature: extract the embedded image directly when a PDF's first page is just a single full-page image (e.g. a scanned cover), instead of rasterizing it
- Pages that also contain text or other content are still rendered normally so nothing is lost
- Extracted images are rotated according to the page's /Rotate value to avoid upside-down covers
Fix: rendered thumbnails now embed pixel-density (DPI) metadata so image viewers report the configured render resolution instead of always defaulting to 96 DPI
- Increase maximum configurable render resolution from 600 to 1000 DPI
description: Automatically generates cover thumbnails for PDF files in your Jellyfin library by rendering the first page of each PDF. Supports configurable render resolution (DPI) and thumbnail padding mode.
name: PDF Thumbnails
overview: Generates thumbnail images from the first page of PDF files.
